- Ellbury account: Overdraft 4,950.
- Garbury project: Budget 1,725.
- Elldale account: Overdraft 5,800.
- Notes: Wren needs afternoon meeting notes. Need to send Nils afternoon meeting notes. Need to send Pia evening meeting notes. Need to send Dell afternoon meeting notes. Need to send Opal evening meeting notes.
